title: Survey: Do you think the Broncos beat the Chiefs in Week 8?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Survey: Do you think the Broncos beat the Chiefs in Week 8?
sources.description: A straight-forward survey this week. With the Denver Broncos getting blown out in Week 1 in Arrowhead, there should be some doubt they can turn it around and beat the Kansas City Chiefs in Week 8. The confidence might come from the fact they were just completely manhandled by the Seattle Seahawks on prime time […]
